diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says GND, datasheet reading says BW
diffs.evidence: Same single 7-hole row, numbered from the opposite end. Datasheet p.2 Pin Out Description: 'Pin 1-BW ... Pin 7-GND'; p.1 mechanical drawing silkscreen reads top to bottom GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW. The part lists the row in printed order starting at GND (its description cites 'datasheet pin 7' for GND), so every name/function pairing matches the datasheet; only the enumeration direction differs.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says +5, datasheet reading says PW
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 6-+5V- Vcc - Operates on 2.5V - 5.5V' and silkscreen order GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW (p.1 drawing): +5 is second from the GND end, i.e. datasheet pin 6; PW is datasheet pin 2 counted from the BW end. Same row read in reverse; part's +5 description correctly says datasheet pin 6.

diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says TX, datasheet reading says AN
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 5-TX- ... asynchronous serial with an RS232 format, except voltages are 0-Vcc' and 'Pin 3-AN- Outputs analog voltage with a scaling factor of (Vcc/512) per inch'. In the printed hole order GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW, TX is third from the GND end (datasheet pin 5); AN is third from the BW end (pin 3). Reversed enumeration of the same row.

diffs.diff: header pin 5: part says AN, datasheet reading says TX
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 3-AN' / 'Pin 5-TX'; silkscreen (p.1 drawing) GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW puts AN fifth from the GND end = datasheet pin 3. Part's AN description says 'pin 3'. Reversed enumeration only.

diffs.diff: header pin 6: part says PW, datasheet reading says +5V
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 2-PW- This pin outputs a pulse width representation of range ... 147uS per inch' and 'Pin 6-+5V'. Silkscreen GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW puts PW sixth from the GND end = datasheet pin 2. Part's PW description says 'pin 2'. Reversed enumeration only.

diffs.diff: header pin 7: part says BW, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 1-BW-*Leave open or hold low for serial output on the TX output' and 'Pin 7-GND- Return for the DC power supply'. Silkscreen GND, +5, TX, RX, AN, PW, BW ends at BW = datasheet pin 1. Part's BW description says 'pin 1'. Reversed enumeration of the same physical row; every label-to-function mapping agrees.

diffs.diff: distance (inches): datasheet reading gives 102.4 per count, the part's model has 155.2
diffs.evidence: Datasheet 'Pin 3-AN- Outputs analog voltage with a scaling factor of (Vcc/512) per inch. A supply of 5V yields ~9.8mV/in. and 3.3V yields ~6.4mV/in.' So inches per volt = 512/Vcc: 102.4 at Vcc=5 V (second reading) and 155.15 at Vcc=3.3 V (part's sim: 6 in -> 0.038672 V = 6*3.3/512, 254 in -> 1.637109 V = 254*3.3/512, as Sparkbench powers it from 3V3). Same formula, different supply voltage; the driver uses inches = V*512/vcc with vcc passed in.
